raw_snippet: Finally, applying SDPO to individual questions at test time accelerates discovery on difficult binary-reward tasks, achieving the same discovery probability as best-of-k sampling or multi-turn conversations with 3x fewer attempts.
note: Hübotter et al. (ETH), Self-Distillation Policy Optimization; v2 2026-02-16. Listed under L5 in Appendix E; the paper is a training method with a per-question test-time variant, not a persistence-across-sessions result, so the placement is by mechanism only.
